description.value: Suppress Ambient Glow at will for short periods, at the cost of minor Fortitude strain.

cinderfall.incomplete: Suppressing Ambient Glow's stealth penalty at will would require adding a new flag to Ambient Glow's own predicate's nor-list (a cross-file change to a different card, out of scope for this file), and no number is given for the 'minor Fortitude strain' cost.
